name: DNCASR-vi Benchmark
description: An open benchmark for speaker-attributed ASR ("who said what") in Vietnamese meetings: a simulation recipe from public Vietnamese audiobooks, evaluation manifests (including 12 hand-annotated real spontaneous clips), a unified cpWER/tcpWER/DER scoring harness, and a datasheet with a data-governance statement. Only time-stamped, speaker-anonymized annotations are released; no source audio is distributed.
